sampling: Deterministic venue-stratified discovery; deduplicate recording IDs and canonical Shabad IDs; do not select by matcher success. Keep Renton as development/regression and unseen venues as evaluation.
truth: Canonical STTM/BaniDB IDs required. Publisher titles, projected slides, and ASR are separate provenance fields; uncertain audio boundaries/pramaans excluded from definitive accuracy denominator. Never label using the evaluated matcher alone.
metrics: time retained on the previous Shabad after a verified transition
line changes within the OLD Shabad after new-Shabad onset (false in-Shabad advances)
transitionRule: Keep natural transitions and at least 30 seconds before new-Shabad onset. An old-Shabad verse change after onset is a flagged event; adjudicate canonical overlap and sung content before declaring it wrong.
streamCaptureVsRoomMic: Report separately; unknown broadcast chain is not assumed to be room microphone.
stopRules: No fabricated labels or replacing the 80-episode goal with 80 unverified URLs.
Bound acquisition retries and persist failures.
No near-duplicate episodes counted as independent successes.
If labels cannot be independently established, publish coverage and provisional diagnostics, not a misleading accuracy rate.
